lines.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
lines.cn: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士（Sir Malcolm Campbell）是第一个驾驶汽车时速超过300英里的人。

lines.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
lines.cn: 他在1935年9月于犹他州的博纳维尔盐滩（Bonneville Salt Flats）创造了新的世界纪录。

lines.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
lines.cn: 他驾驶的那辆名为“Bluebird”的汽车，是专门为他定制制造的。

lines.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2, 500-horsepower engine.
lines.cn: 它的长度超过了30英尺（约9米），配备了一台功率为2500马力的发动机。

lines.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour,
lines.cn: 尽管坎贝尔的速度超过了每小时304英里，

lines.en: he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
lines.cn: 他在驾驶汽车时遇到了很大的困难，因为汽车在第一次行驶过程中就爆了一个轮胎。

lines.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
lines.cn: 尝试之后，坎贝尔得知自己的平均速度仅为每小时299英里，这让他感到非常失望。

lines.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
lines.cn: 然而，几天后他被告知，原来出现了一个错误。

lines.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
lines.cn: 他的平均速度是每小时301英里。

lines.en: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
lines.cn: 从那时起，赛车手的行驶速度已经超过了每小时600英里。

lines.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
lines.cn: 许多年后，唐纳德继承了他父亲的脚步，也创造了一项世界纪录。

lines.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
lines.cn: 和他父亲一样，他驾驶着一辆名叫“Bluebird”的汽车。
